shortDescription: **NOTE: This module has been deprecated in favor of `type_list`.** List and filter on Instance Types.

options.name: count
options.description: The number of Instance Types to return. If undefined, all results will be returned.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply to the resulting Instance Types.

options.name: order
options.description: The order to list Instance Types in.

options.name: order_by
options.description: The attribute to order Instance Types by.
